convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for Fisher_org_v1_Sign custom indicator, depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position sizing and trade execution logic, requires custom indicator files to replicate in Python

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal time calculation
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime assignment for trade execution timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator to be ready

other_exits: BUY_Close triggered when Fisher_org_v1_Sign buffer 0 (Dn arrow) is non-zero on SignalBar or on any historical bar scanned forward from SignalBar+1
SELL_Close triggered when Fisher_org_v1_Sign buffer 1 (Up arrow) is non-zero on SignalBar or on any historical bar scanned forward from SignalBar+1

Oppposite signal scanning: when both open and close on same side are enabled but no close signal yet, EA scans bars from SignalBar+1 forward looking for a close signal to avoid opening without a known exit

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM input (0.1) is the multiplier/fraction depending on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: EA uses a two-buffer custom indicator (Fisher_org_v1_Sign) where buffer 1 = buy signal arrows and buffer 0 = sell signal arrows. Signal is read from SignalBar (default bar 1 = previous completed bar). When both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are enabled but no close signal is detected on the signal bar, the EA scans forward through historical bars (SignalBar+1 onward) to find the earliest close signal, ensuring it knows the exit before entering. The Recount static flag ensures signal recalculation on copy failures. BuyPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose input booleans act as feature toggles. SignalTime is computed as SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for trade execution timing passed to TradeAlgorithms functions.
python_conversion_notes: Requires replicating the Fisher_org_v1_Sign custom indicator logic in Python (Fisher transform with ATR period, length, custom price types including PRICE_SIMPL_, PRICE_QUARTER_, PRICE_TRENDFOLLOW0_, PRICE_TRENDFOLLOW1_, PRICE_DEMARK_). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles position sizing (5 margin modes), order open/close with deviation, and global variable management - all must be reimplemented. The ATR_Period=14 is hardcoded (not an input) which is unusual. The forward-scanning close signal detection (scanning bars after SignalBar to find exit before entry) is non-trivial and must be faithfully reproduced. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 pips suggest this is designed for 5-digit brokers (effectively 100/200 pips), so digit adjustment logic may be needed in Python. The custom enum ENUM_APPLIED_PRICE_ extends beyond standard MT5 price types and will need custom implementation for the non-standard price calculations.
